caption: The drawing features two metallic spoons depicted in a horizontal arrangement, placed one above the other on a neutral, light beige background. Both spoons are rendered in grayscale, utilizing pencil shading to create a realistic effect with highlights and shadows. The upper spoon is positioned with its handle to the right and its bowl to the left, drawn at a slight angle that shows the curvature of its bowl. The lower spoon is similarly oriented but is drawn with more emphasis on the handle's detailing and the reflective surface of the bowl. The spoons have gently curved handles and shallow, oval bowls. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition, and the artist’s signature, “Charles M. Dazjan,” is located in the lower right corner.
title: Two Silver Soup Spoons
